title: Storefront page
summary: An ecommerce storefront composed from a site header, a product grid, a promo band, and a footer — reusing the marketing header/footer for chrome.
brief: Build a shoppable storefront / category page: a marketing-header for site nav, a commerce-product-grid as the catalog, a marketing-cta promo band, and a marketing-footer. Product cards link to detail pages (commerce-product-detail), which in turn lead to commerce-cart and commerce-checkout. Keep colors on semantic tokens so the store restyles with the theme; product imagery is supplied by the consumer.

sections.intent: Storefront nav with brand, categories, and cart link.
A promotional band (sale, newsletter, free shipping).
Store navigation, policies, and social links.

layout: Stack vertically in declared order inside a single page wrapper. Header first, footer last. The product grid is the body; drop the optional promo band when there's nothing to promote. Product cards (href set) navigate to commerce-product-detail; that page links onward to commerce-cart and commerce-checkout, which are separate routes rather than sections of this page.

checklist.check: [MarketingHeader] Avoid: Passing more than ~5 links — the inline row gets crowded; group secondary items under the CTA or a footer.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , losing button styling.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Forgetting the logo links to '/' — wrap the logo node in an anchor.

[MarketingHeader] A11y: The mobile toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at the panel and an aria-label that flips between 'Open menu' / 'Close menu'. Links are real anchors, keyboard-focusable, with visible focus rings.
[CommerceProductGrid] Avoid: Omitting alt text on product images, so the catalog isn't navigable by screen reader.
[CommerceProductGrid] Avoid: Mixing image aspect ratios — the grid uses a square frame; supply consistently cropped images.
[CommerceProductGrid] Avoid: Putting the price inside the name instead of the price field, breaking the layout alignment.

[CommerceProductGrid] A11y: When href is set the whole card is a single anchor wrapping the image and text, so there's one focusable target per product with an accessible name from the product name. Product images require alt text.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: On variant='panel', passing a primary <Button> — it disappears against the primary background; use variant='secondary' or 'outline'.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: Omitting actions entirely — a CTA with no button is just a heading.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: Stacking multiple panel CTAs, creating competing focal points.
[MarketingCta] A11y: Renders an <h2>, keeping it below the hero's <h1>. On variant='panel', button contrast must clear WCAG against the primary fill — prefer secondary/outline buttons.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: One column with 20 links instead of a few grouped columns — group by topic.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Omitting the copyright line, which most footers are expected to carry.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Putting social icons with no accessible label — wrap each in a link with an aria-label or sr-only text.

[MarketingFooter] A11y: Each column title renders as an <h3>. Links are real anchors with visible hover/focus states. Social icon links need an accessible name (aria-label or sr-only text) since the icon alone isn't announced.
